doctrine: ads8: five spec ads (grok, zai, moonshot, claude, claudecode), ads7 grammar: absurd open, plain model, visual quirk never narrated, mouths closed, centre-square composition, guard verbatim
guard: Natural skin texture with visible pores and slight imperfections, documentary realism, no beauty smoothing, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing with small human hesitations. No readable on-screen text anywhere in frame, no logos, no brand marks. Keep hands either fully out of frame or large, simple and clearly articulated. NO narration, NO voiceover, NO captions, NO avatar or presenter, no music, natural ambient sound only. One single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, subject centered, raw b-roll for an edit. Composed for a centered square crop: every story object stays inside the middle third of the frame and never approaches the left or right edge.

perplexity.positioning: An answer engine that searches and synthesises with citations attached (verified: perplexity.ai hub, help centre)
perplexity.quirk: one page keeps floating after the rest have gone, upside down, and settles last
perplexity.bed: Cool focused modern instrumental, clean electric piano, subtle pulse, clear and confident night-work feeling, no vocals
perplexity.narration: 400 tabs, ten blue links, and still no answer. Perplexity is an answer engine: it reads the web and hands back the answer with its sources attached. One page, not 400.
perplexity.closer: Perplexity, the answer engine with its sources attached. Ask it your next question. The pipeline behind this spot is public, link under the video.

scenes.a: From the inherited desk view, hundreds of pages ERUPT from the open laptop within the first second, fountain overhead and avalanche around {character} to chest height. Eyes widen; shoulders brace. Keep the camera fixed, face unobscured and action in the middle third. Pages bear only illegible gray print. End with paper still roaring above the buried desk. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.b: From the inherited paper avalanche, {character} stays braced as the storm abruptly reverses: loose sheets whip upward from chest and desk into a tight spinning column that rises beside her and hangs above her head, never in front of her face. The open laptop stays open on the desk. Keep the same fixed medium framing, her face clear at every moment. Illegible print only. The desk clears; one stray sheet tumbles above the column. End with the column suspended above her head, her face fully clear, and one palm opening at chest height. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.c: From the suspended column, the paper snaps inward within one second into one crisp sheet above {character}'s open palm. One stray remains floating upside down beside the face: illegible print bands sit below its broad blank margin. Hold this readable arrangement through the end, with tiny drifting motion. Same fixed medium view; face, palm and both sheets inside the middle third. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
scenes.d: From the inherited two-sheet arrangement, the upside-down stray wobbles once and settles last onto the crisp sheet in {character}'s palm by one second, compressing flush into a single sheet without a stacked edge. By two seconds, eyes lower to read; shoulders release. Hold the calm reading in the clean lamplit office through the end. Fixed medium framing, illegible print only. Mouth closed, nobody speaks.
